description: This source file defines the ExecutorAllocationManager class in Apache Spark, responsible for dynamically managing executor resources based on workload, including adding and removing executors according to workload metrics and configuration settings. It also includes a nested listener class for Spark events and a metrics source class for exposing internal status.

classes.name: ExecutorAllocationManager
classes.description: Manages dynamic allocation of executors in Spark based on workload metrics and configuration.

classes.name: ExecutorAllocationManagerSource
classes.description: Metrics source exposing internal status of ExecutorAllocationManager.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initializes event listeners and scheduling for executor management.

methods.name: stop
methods.description: Shuts down the executor scheduling thread.

methods.name: reset
methods.description: Resets internal state, typically after cluster manager restart.

methods.name: maxNumExecutorsNeededPerResourceProfile
methods.description: Calculates maximum executors needed for a resource profile based on current workload.

methods.name: schedule
methods.description: Periodically invoked to add or remove executors based on workload.

methods.name: updateAndSyncNumExecutorsTarget
methods.description: Adjusts target executor counts and syncs with cluster manager.

methods.name: decrementExecutors
methods.description: Reduces target executor count for a resource profile.

methods.name: doUpdateRequest
methods.description: Sends executor count updates to the cluster manager.

methods.name: onSchedulerBacklogged
methods.description: Sets a timer to add executors when backlog is detected.

methods.name: onSchedulerQueueEmpty
methods.description: Clears backlog timers when queue is empty.
